claim: A viral video claims the Parliament passed a law banning private savings accounts
explanation: No such law exists; video is digitally altered footage of an unrelated session

claim: Circulating message claims free laptops are being distributed via a government scheme with a registration link
explanation: No such scheme exists; the link is a phishing page impersonating a government portal

claim: A video shows the Finance Minister announcing a new tax on bank withdrawals starting next month
explanation: Audio has been synthetically altered; original speech made no such announcement

claim: An Instagram account impersonating the Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs is posting fake notices
explanation: The account is not affiliated with the Government of India
